instrument: Kittitas County emergency moratorium on data center land-use applications (Aug 2026; extended Sept 2026)
summary: Emergency six-month moratorium on accepting and processing land-use applications for data centers in unincorporated county, extended six more months after a public hearing, for about a year in total; no applications had been received.

source.citation: Daily Record; Yakima Herald-Republic; Skamania Dispatch; MyNorthwest (June-Sept 2026)
